name: WorkerLocalTransport

test_list.description: A real Windows named-pipe client verifies missing/wrong worker credentials are rejected, authenticates the Ingest handshake and CAS request, then shuts it down and observes endpoint removal.
A second first-instance pipe listener for the same name fails synchronously rather than returning a successful but unserved endpoint.

inputs.description: Temporary bounded CAS root for round-trip ingest.

output_description: Verified authenticated local transport handshake, real CAS-backed ingest, lifecycle shutdown, and endpoint teardown.
